limitations: Finite connected symmetric-weight graphs, jointly reset multiple vertices, fixed parameters and exact unwrapped linear phase dynamics only; no claims for nonlinear Kuramoto or independent reset clocks. A plausible broader 2026 source was not fully accessible.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof plus finite numerical checks. One-reset-vertex cubic covariance is acknowledged as prior and is not represented as a new result. All-priority originality and independent validation are not certified.
title: Dual Krylov criteria for stochastic-reset noise transmission in finite oscillator networks
